title: God Armor & Items
description: This datapack adds different godly items that can be crafted
body:
**THIS IS SMP FOCUSED**


A set of god-tier items.

Each is built from netherite base. Crafted using ingredients that are rare.

God Helmet --> +5 health. 

God Chestplate --> Thorns 5, and strength 1.

God Leggings --> 5 block fall and fire protection 4.

God Boots --> Speed equivalent to speed 3 effect. 

God Sword --> buffed enchantments and includes wind burst 2. 

God Axe --> Buffed enchantments (More coming soon). 

God Pickaxe --> Sharpness 3 and can insta mine stone.


All Pieces are unbreakable


CHECK GALLERY FOR RECIPES AND DETAILS

More MIGHT be coming soon...

Requirement:

A datapack or mod that adds player head dropping (Recommended : https://modrinth.com/datapack/players-drop-heads)

Minecraft java 1.21+ (Tested on 26.1.2)

Suggestions and Issues report here

https://github.com/Cr4zeh/God-Armor-Items/issues
